reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) demonstrates that carbon doping in a different HEA system (Fe-Mn-Co-Cr) can activate TWIP/TRIP and form nano-carbides, but it does not provide specific support for coherent carbide formation, Orowan strengthening, or plasticity enhancement in a tungsten-based refractory HEA. E3 shows carbide formation in a RHEA only under high pressure, not ambient conditions, and reports no plasticity data. Thus, the key premises about the mechanism and outcome in the proposed W-based system lack direct prior evidence.
premises: Carbon doping at ~0.15 at.% in a W-based RHEA will form coherent nanoscale carbide precipitates
These coherent precipitates will enhance yield strength via Orowan strengthening
Coherent interfaces will promote additional deformation mechanisms (twinning/TRIP) that improve plasticity
The combined effect yields simultaneous improvement in strength and plasticity over a carbon-free baseline
